name: AppleMotion
summary: Idle, walk and attack for any rigged creature, made by code from the rig's own joints. No Animation assets, so no private-animation T-pose.

needs.creatures: Models with at least one Motor6D or Bone, standing in their rest pose. A model with none gets one from AppleMotion.prepare at build time.
needs.tag: Each creature model is tagged AppleCreature (AppleMotion.prepare does it).
needs.movement: Something moves the creature's root (a wave or AI system). The driver measures the speed; nothing else is required.
needs.streaming: With StreamingEnabled a creature streams as one piece (prepare sets ModelStreamingMode Atomic).

gives.idle: breathing body, nodding head, swaying arms, wagging tail, flapping wings
gives.walk: legs in opposition (bipeds) or diagonal pairs (four or more legs), counter-swinging arms, body bob; legless bodies hop and waddle
gives.attack: set the model attribute MotionAttack to a new number: a lunge with raised arms over 0.45 s

limits: Bone-skinned rigs move by their bones; a fruit can only be attached rigidly to them, so fruit creatures use Motor6D bodies.
Animation runs on each client only (Transform does not replicate), which is what Roblox does for its own animations.
